rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a poor-quality early blastocyst with absent/degenerate ICM and sparse TE, consistent with 0DD. Minor overreach in suggesting expansion may approach full blastocyst and in inferring specific debris details from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with the poor embryo morphology to frame prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately driven by very poor embryo quality and adverse history. Some quantitative adjustments and causal inferences are more speculative than firmly supported.

Mostly aligned on counseling, RPL/RIF workup, and cautious prognosis, but includes several recommendations with limited or controversial guideline support (ERA, NK/immunologic testing, routine thrombophilia expansion, GH, TESE-ICSI for DFI, assisted hatching as broad recommendation).
Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer counseling, luteal support, targeted future investigations, and cycle-planning options with useful prioritization and nuance.
